meta.title: 海边pose机 | 7个姿势拿捏夏日氛围感

scenes.context: 以背影看海的姿势开场，利用辽阔海景制造意境感。
sentences: Face the sea with your back to the camera.
back to the camera（背对镜头）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达背影看海
Turn away and let the wide ocean fill the frame.
It gives the shot a calm, cinematic vibe.
scenes.speak: Face the sea with your back to the camera. It creates a moody, cinematic feel.

scenes.title_en: Middle: Side Angle and Hair Toss
scenes.context: 侧身回头、撩发利用海风带动发丝与裙摆。
sentences: Toss your hair and let the sea breeze carry it.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达侧身动作
Angle your body and look over your shoulder.
换种说法表达海风撩发
Let the wind lift your hair for a natural movement.
scenes.speak: Turn sideways and glance back. Toss your hair and let the sea breeze carry it.

scenes.context: 回眸看镜头收尾，画面定格氛围感拉满。
sentences: Turn back and hold eye contact with the camera.
paraphrase: Look over your shoulder straight into the lens.
Hold the pose so the shot feels complete.
scenes.speak: Turn back and hold eye contact with the camera, then freeze the frame.
